verdicts.reason: A keeps the original's three-column layout with clean hierarchy and spacing. Its flaws are small: the window sits slightly off-centre and there is a lot of empty space above and below. B squeezes the date and address into a narrow right column with bad line breaks ('November / 13, 11 a.m.', 'St. Mary / Church', 'Crossover / ave, 2-3') and pushes that text against the right edge. It also lets the stained-glass window run into the top and bottom edges, and the larger headline breaks with 'Sunday' alone on the last line, leaving the composition cramped and unbalanced.
